settings.resetBody: This deletes all kana progress, XP, streaks and settings. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetStep2Body: There is no undo. Export a backup first if you want to keep your progress.
about.title: About Yuxi
about.body: Yuxi is a friendly, offline companion for learning Japanese kana in Urdu and English. No account, no ads, no tracking.
about.creditsBody: Built with Expo, React Native, Noto fonts and open-source software. The Yuxi mascot artwork is original and supplied by the project owner.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Yuxi is private by design. Your progress stays on your device.
privacy.noAccountBody: You never sign in, and we never ask for personal details.
privacy.noNetworkBody: The app works fully offline. There are no analytics, crash reports, ads or tracking SDKs.
privacy.noAdsBody: Yuxi does not include advertising or ad SDKs.
privacy.notificationsBody: Only when you turn on the daily reminder. Android asks for permission at that moment. Yuxi schedules one local reminder on your device; no push server is used.
privacy.hapticsBody: Used for light feedback on quiz answers when haptics are enabled in Settings.
privacy.filesBody: Only when you choose to export or import a backup. The file stays under your control.
privacy.speechBody: Uses the Japanese voice installed on your device to pronounce kana. No audio is sent anywhere.
licenses.title: Open-source licenses
licenses.intro: Yuxi is built with open-source software. Thank you to every maintainer.
licenses.fontBody: Noto Sans JP and Noto Nastaliq Urdu are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
